description: Married filing separately: § 164(b)(7)(B) phases the $40,000 amount down by 30% of MAGI over HALF the $500,000 threshold and floors it at $10,000; § 164(b)(6)(B) then halves the result (State and Local Tax Deduction Worksheet line 10). MFS 2025, AGI $300,000, SALT paid $30,000: $40,000 − 30% × $50,000 = $25,000; half = $12,500. (Halving the amount first gave $20,000 − $15,000 = $5,000.)
